patent_grounding.rationale: Revision 5's subsystem descriptions, contact/coupling/support relationships, and behavior statements are supported by the cited patent passages. Embodiment-specific details are explicitly qualified; no unsupported numeric engineering constraints are asserted.

functional_completeness.rationale: The modeled core wave-generator/FTE interaction and the previously identified spline coupling, running-tooth mesh/torque transfer, sliding support, and cover engagement are represented. No further major supported relationship appears omitted within the stated assembly scope.

flow_consistency.rationale: WG wg_contact (out) and FTE fte_wg_contact (in) are joined via fte_wg_contour_contact using flow_ref contour_contact; both ports and the flow are mechanical_contact. The contour-induced deformation is separately described as an internal transformation, not mislabeled as the contact interface.

claim_traceability.rationale: The represented features trace to the cited claim/embodiment evidence, and optional embodiment details are qualified. No fabricated requirement or constraint is presented as a patent fact.

interfaces.rationale: All listed interfaces reference existing subsystem and port IDs and flow IDs, and connect compatible flow types. The revision-4 dangling WG/FTE contour-contact ports are now coherently connected. Previously identified sliding-support and separate rotational torque-transfer interfaces remain distinct and compatible.

textbook_application.rationale: Textbook context/boundary and allocation guidance is used only to inform modeling scope and structure, not as evidence for invention facts. The assembly boundary and omission of unspecified external prime mover/load are reasonable for this model.

summary: Revision 5 resolves prior finding R4-1: the wave-generator and flexible-element contour-contact ports are connected by a correctly typed mechanical-contact interface, while induced deformation remains an internal transformation. Previously identified relationships remain distinct and connected, structural checks are clean, and review found no unresolved or newly introduced issues.
